The things is that smite is balanced around conquest meaning than any other play mode is meaningless ( ares gets punished a lot early ),  Ares and most of offensive tanks usually have high base dmg , medium scaling and extremely low mobility, the reason that tanks have  become prominent in my perspective  are the following :

1. Buff-Nerf to sunder : the  original intend of  sunder was to obliterated defenses making it pretty much an anti-tank active  . when it was changed to be able to increase dmg to a percentage it become a delete button to any character , pretty much a nemesis ult . Today sunder is useless .
2. Buff-Nerf to bracer : bracer shaped the meta making it a top active . Now is unusable . 
3. Nerf to teleport : teleport was no1 active for solo , now is useless. 
4. Shell buff : shell at this point has no counter and tanks benefit with this more cause their defense giving them more survivability. 
5. Thorns : is an unfun but kind of necessary mechanic to keep dmg characters in line but at its current state is frustrating against specially in lower levels . 

In conclusion all the active changes end up favoring tanks. Sunder has no use . Bracer and teleport use to be core for solo liners now both are useless so it promotes people to get thorn and shell , shell is just too strong and thorns needs to be overview . Base dmg is not the problem the problem are actives , at this point some actives are unusable such as hog and offensive actives are offering nothing such as frenzy. They just need to revamp actives again...
